note: Runtime UI rows whose translation is wrong in sense. The guides use a correct term; these rows need a runtime-catalog fix.

defects.Anndata out: 'Annoncés' means 'announced'; the setting is the AnnData output file ('Sortie AnnData')
defects.Anndata nan policy: 'Politique des données' reads 'data policy' and loses the missing-value (NaN) meaning ('Politique NaN AnnData')
defects.Model zoo…: 'Modèle zoo...' is a word-for-word rendering; the screen is 'Bibliothèque de modèles'
defects.Promote calls to annotation: 'Promouvoir les appels à l'annotation' reads 'promote calls for annotation'; the action turns calls into annotations
defects.Undo promotion: 'Annulation de la promotion' reads as cancelling a (sales/job) promotion
defects.Re-flood below the escape: 'Refonte au-dessous de l'échappée' ('recasting below the breakaway') has no meaning here
defects.Taper onto the gradient: 'Taper sur le dégradé' means 'to type/hit on the colour gradient'
defects.Train: 'Le train' is a railway train; the Workbench tab means 'Entraîner'
defects.Walk: 'Marcher' means walking on foot; the switch selects the local step-by-step search ('Recherche pas à pas')
defects.Outputs: 'Produits' means 'products'; the workflow card lists outputs ('Sorties')
defects.Setting animations: 'Configuration des animations' reads 'configuring animations'; the preference means animations for settings ('Animations des paramètres')
